bands.blurb: More than an index entry but still mostly links rather than artifacts.

providers.name: Automatic Data Processing (ADP)
providers.description: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) is a global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions including payroll processing, benefits administration, talent management, time and attendance, workforce analytics, and tax compliance services. ADP serves over 1 million businesses worldwide and provides a comprehensive developer platform with REST APIs, SDKs, and marketplace integrations for HCM system connectivity.

providers.name: Deloitte
providers.description: Deloitte is one of the Big Four professional services organizations, operating through a network of member firms coordinated by Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited (DTTL). The organization spans approximately 150 countries and territories, has more than 180 years of history (founded 1845), and serves roughly 90% of the Fortune Global 500. Deloitte organizes delivery across four primary service lines — Audit & Assurance, Consulting, Tax, and Legal — plus specialized cross-functional practices including Business Process Solutions and Global Employer Services. Consulting offerings cover Customer, Cyber, Engineering / AI & Data, Enterprise Technology & Performance, Finance Transformation, Human Capital, Strategy & Transactions, and Risk / Regulatory & Forensic. Deloitte Digital is the technology-and-experience practice with alliances spanning Salesforce, Adobe, SAP, Google Cloud, AWS, ServiceNow, Oracle, Shopify, Sitecore, and Genesys, and accelerators such as FrontOffice Advantage, Revenue Advantage, Agentic Marketing Cloud, CreativEdge, Blueprint, Content Studios, and TrustID. The organization serves six industries divided into twenty sectors: Consumer; Energy, Resources & Industrials; Financial Services; Government & Public Services; Life Sciences & Health Care; and Technology, Media & Telecommunications. Deloitte Insights is the organization's research-publishing surface, organized into eight research centers — Cross-Industry, Economics, Consumer, Energy & Industrials, Financial Services, Government & Public Services, Life Sciences & Health Care, and Tech, Media & Telecom — producing flagship series including Tech Trends, Global Human Capital Trends, Digital Media Trends, TMT Predictions, FSI Predictions, the Weekly Global Economic Outlook, and the annual Industry Outlooks. The Deloitte AI Institute drives applied-AI research and points of view. Deloitte does not publish a public developer API or open developer portal at the corporate level. The Deloitte US Consulting GitHub organization is small (5 visible repositories, mostly archived upstream forks; the original artifact is `beacon`, a first-party web-analytics packaging library in TypeScript). Reader-facing distribution flows through MyDeloitte (personalized content + newsletter subscriptions), Dbriefs (live webcasts with CPE credit), the Deloitte Insights Magazine, and the YouTube channel; no public RSS index page was discoverable on www.deloitte.com at the path published in legacy archives.

providers.name: IRS
providers.description: The US Internal Revenue Service (IRS) provides REST APIs and Application-to-Application (A2A) interfaces for tax information access, identity verification, income verification, information return filing, and taxpayer account data. Authorized applications can integrate with IRS e-Services for TIN matching, the Transcript Delivery System (TDS), the Income Verification Express Service (IVES), the Information Return Intake System (IRIS) for 1099 series filings, and the Modernized e-File (MeF) system for electronic tax return submission. Access requires enrollment in IRS e-Services and obtaining an API client ID.

providers.name: VAT API
providers.description: EU and UK VAT compliance REST API providing VAT rate retrieval, VAT number validation via the European Commission VIES system and UK HMRC, currency conversion, and VAT-compliant invoice generation. Operated by Eventured Ltd and launched in 2015, it connects directly to authoritative EU and HMRC sources to deliver audit-ready consultation numbers and real-time rate data.

providers.name: Earnipay
providers.description: Earnipay is a Nigerian fintech that operates an NRS/FIRS-compliant e-invoicing platform for businesses. As an accredited Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS) and NITDA systems integrator, Earnipay lets developers programmatically create businesses, manage customers and products, generate FIRS-compliant invoices with IRN (Invoice Reference Number) and QR codes, and submit them to the tax authority through an Access Point Provider (APP) connection. The public Earnipay Invoicing API is an OpenAPI 3.0.0 REST service covering authentication, businesses, customers, products, payment details, invoices, IRN and QR generation, bank lookup/verification, and team management. It authenticates with JWT bearer tokens for user-facing flows and an X-API-Key header for third-party integrations. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Canaan Partners.

providers.name: Black Ore Technologies
providers.description: Black Ore Technologies is an Austin, Texas AI company building AI infrastructure for tax and financial services. Founded in 2022 by Eyal Shinar (previously founder of the fintech unicorn Fundbox) and Pavel Kapovski, the company emerged from stealth in November 2023 with $60 million in funding led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and Oak HC/FT. Its flagship product, Tax Autopilot, combines proprietary AI with federal and state tax codes to autonomously execute the full lifecycle of complex tax returns for Certified Public Accountants and accounting firms, spanning document ingestion, intelligent extraction, return preparation, workpaper generation, and tax software integration (UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect). The platform covers 1040 individual returns plus 1041, 1065, and Schedule K-1/K-3 automation, and is used by 40% of the top 20 leading firms. Black Ore does not publish a public developer API or OpenAPI at this time; its authentication is handled by an Auth0-hosted OpenID Connect tenant at auth.blackore.ai.

providers.name: Everlance
providers.description: Everlance is an automatic mileage and expense tracking platform for self-employed professionals, gig workers, contractors, and businesses, building an infrastructure platform for the self-employed. Its apps capture GPS-based mileage automatically, sync bank and credit-card transactions to categorize expenses, surface tax deductions, and generate IRS-compliant reports. For teams and enterprises, Everlance offers a Business API that enables uni-directional data transfer into the platform to keep user profiles, user attributes, team structure and roles, and favorite places up to date, plus an HR integration (powered by Merge) that syncs employee details from 100+ HRIS systems such as ADP, UKG, and Workday. The Business API authenticates with a Bearer access token provisioned by the Everlance team.

providers.name: TaxNexus
providers.description: TaxNexus is a cannabis tax compliance REST API and financial technology service that automates calculation of state, county, and local cannabis excise taxes across supported jurisdictions including California and Oregon. Cannabis POS and ERP software developers can integrate with the TaxNexus API to calculate excise taxes, track and store tax data, and file monthly cannabis tax returns. The platform serves cannabis businesses, software makers, and accountants seeking to automate real-world cannabis tax compliance problems for recreational and medical cannabis taxpayers.

providers.name: Wealthsimple
providers.description: Wealthsimple is a Toronto-based Canadian financial technology company, founded in 2014, offering a full suite of consumer financial products: managed investing (Invest), self-directed stock and ETF trading (Trade), cryptocurrency, tax filing (Tax), spending, saving, and cash and card products. It serves more than four million Canadians with roughly CAD $125 billion in assets under administration and reached a CAD $10 billion valuation in its 2025 Series F round. Wealthsimple does not publish an official public developer API or OpenAPI specification; programmatic account access is available only through open-banking aggregators (SnapTrade, Plaid) and community-built unofficial libraries. This profile captures the company's public trust, security, and developer-adjacent surface (security.txt, HackerOne bug bounty, Trust Center, status page, verified GitHub organization).

providers.name: IVIX
providers.description: IVIX is an AI-powered financial-intelligence platform that analyzes publicly available data at scale to surface hidden and unreported business activity, helping government tax authorities and law-enforcement agencies combat the shadow economy, tax evasion, and financial crime. The platform ingests open and third-party data to detect non-compliant businesses, quantify unreported revenue (including short-term rentals and crypto markets), and map illicit networks for enforcement teams. IVIX is a closed, government-facing product — it is sold and deployed with authorities rather than exposed as a public self-serve API — and it is ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certified for information security. Backed by Insight Partners; headquartered in New York with former IRS Commissioner Charles Rettig on its board of advisors.

providers.name: Bloomberg Tax (BTAX)
providers.description: Bloomberg Tax (BTAX) is a comprehensive tax research, planning, and compliance platform providing tax professionals with authoritative primary sources, expert analysis, and practical tools. Bloomberg Tax covers federal, state, and international tax law and provides data APIs for integrating tax rates, regulations, and guidance into enterprise tax technology workflows.

providers.name: Blue J
providers.description: Blue J is an AI-powered tax research platform that delivers defensible, source-backed answers to complex tax questions in seconds, drawing on primary law plus Tax Notes and IBFD content. Built for tax professionals, the platform supports advisory, compliance, tax writing, and training workflows, and is trusted by 4,000+ firms including Crowe, RSM, and Larson. Blue J is a SaaS product accessed through its web application at app.askbluej.com; it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or MCP server. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Sapphire Ventures and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from Blue J's own public website, security, pricing, and trust-center pages.

providers.name: Accordance Ai
providers.description: Accordance (operated by Agnetic Labs Inc.) is a San Francisco frontier AI platform built for tax, audit, and accounting professionals. Founded by researchers from the Stanford AI Lab, it provides a firmwide agentic AI platform that performs tax research with authoritative code, context, and citations, complex accounting analysis, and audit insight — with visible reasoning and verifiable source citations. Accordance is SOC 2 Type II certified, never trains on customer data, and is backed by Menlo Ventures, Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and New Enterprise Associates. The product surface is the Accordance application (app.accordance.ai); no public developer API is currently documented.

providers.name: Neo.Tax
providers.description: Neo.Tax is an AI-powered tax automation platform that helps enterprises and their accounting teams generate audit-ready R&D tax credit studies, software capitalization (ASC 350-40), and R&D capitalization (IRC Section 174) documentation. The platform ingests engineering and financial data from tools like Jira, GitHub, payroll systems, and Workday and uses large language models and agentic AI to qualify projects under IRC Section 41, eliminating the manual surveys and interviews that traditionally drive R&D tax credit work. Neo.Tax is backed by GV and Uncork Capital and delivered as a closed enterprise SaaS product; it operates a customer application, a help center, a public status page, and a trust center (SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, GDPR) but does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Tax Templates
providers.description: Pre-designed templates for organizing and filing tax documents and returns. Financial institutions and enterprises use these templates to streamline tax operations and manage fiscal responsibilities. Covers tax document collection, structured data formats for financial disclosures, corporate tax returns, and regulatory compliance frameworks across jurisdictions.

providers.name: DataSnipper
providers.description: DataSnipper is an AI-powered, agentic productivity platform built specifically for audit, tax, and finance teams. It automates repetitive testing and analysis work - extracting, matching, and analyzing data across documents and systems - while keeping human professionals in control of final decisions. Capabilities include AI Agents for end-to-end workflows (revenue testing, tests of detail, royalty calculations), Excel Agents that run analysis directly inside spreadsheets, and document intelligence that collects and cross-references evidence. The platform serves external audit, internal audit, tax, financial control, government audit, and advisory teams, with a security-first posture (no training on customer data, encryption, and 24-hour document deletion). Backed by Index Ventures and Insight Partners.

providers.name: HubSync
providers.description: HubSync is an AI-powered, end-to-end tax and accounting workflow platform built for CPA firms, founded in 2019 by John McGowan and headquartered in Franklin, Tennessee. The SaaS platform unifies the engagement lifecycle in one interface: engagement letter generation and tracking, tax organizers and prepared-by-client data collection, document management, e-signature (including IRS Form 8879), batch federal and state extensions, tax return breakup and delivery, e-file status tracking, web-based tax workpapers, firm analytics dashboards, and integrated bill-and-pay. Its HubSync Halo layer adds agentic AI orchestration across those stages. HubSync publishes an llms.txt and states that it ships a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and bi-directional API integrations with CCH Axcess/ProSystem fx, Thomson Reuters GoSystem/UltraTax and SurePrep, but it publishes no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI description or endpoint documentation — the entire integration surface is provisioned per customer firm.

providers.name: BossTax
providers.description: BossTax is a mobile bookkeeping and tax-filing app for 1099 workers, freelancers, and independent contractors. Founded in 2022 and based in Stamford, Connecticut, BossTax lets self-employed users track expenses by photographing receipts, automatically categorize deductions, log expenses hands-free by voice, manage separate business banking, and file federal, state, and local taxes with a licensed tax professional for a single flat fee with no subscriptions. BossTax is an IRS-authorized Electronic Return Originator (ERO) and is backed by Bloomberg Beta and Boyd Street Ventures. The company ships iOS and Android consumer apps; it publishes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface at this time, so this profile tracks the company identity and public web properties in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Collective
providers.description: Collective is an all-in-one financial back-office platform built for self-employed entrepreneurs, solopreneurs, and businesses-of-one. It bundles S Corp formation and election, bookkeeping, payroll (as a Gusto partner), business and personal tax preparation and filing, quarterly tax planning, and a dedicated accounting team into a single membership. Roughly 12,000 members use Collective to optimize self-employment taxes, with members reporting average annual business-tax savings around $10,000. Collective is a private fintech company backed by General Catalyst, Kindred Ventures, and QED Investors. It currently exposes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface; this profile captures its public web, security, and compliance footprint for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: PayPro Global
providers.description: PayPro Global is an all-in-one Merchant of Record platform that lets SaaS, software, video game, and AI tool companies sell globally. The platform handles international payments, subscription billing, tax compliance, fraud prevention, and revenue recovery, and exposes APIs and webhooks for managing subscriptions, payments, and customer data.

providers.name: Pilot
providers.description: Pilot provides bookkeeping, tax, and CFO services for startups and small businesses, pairing purpose-built financial software with a team of finance experts and former operators. Its offerings include monthly bookkeeping, corporate tax preparation and filing, R&D tax credit studies, fractional CFO and COO support, and stock administration. Pilot serves venture-backed startups and growing SMBs, integrating with accounting and payroll tools to deliver accurate books and financial reporting. Pilot is backed by CRV, Foundry Group, Index Ventures, SV Angel, Techstars, and Union Square Ventures. As of this profile Pilot does not publish a public developer API or developer portal; its product is delivered as a managed service through its web application.

providers.name: Finaloop
providers.description: Finaloop is a real-time, ecommerce-native bookkeeping and accounting platform for direct-to-consumer (DTC) and multichannel brands. It replaces QuickBooks/Xero, human bookkeepers, and integration tooling with automation plus a team of ecommerce accounting experts, delivering always-current financials. Finaloop continuously syncs sales, returns, fees, reimbursements, inventory movements, COGS, and banking across 60+ ecommerce, marketplace, payment, banking, lending, and 3PL integrations (Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, PayPal, Stripe, Chase, ShipBob, and more) to produce real-time P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statements, inventory analytics, and tax services. Finaloop exposes no public developer API; its APIs are internal connectors to source platforms, so this profile is identity- and posture-focused rather than spec-bearing.

providers.name: Getbasis
providers.description: Basis (getbasis.ai) is an AI-powered accounting platform that builds autonomous agents purpose-built for accountants. Its agents execute accounting workflows end-to-end across tax, audit, advisory, and client accounting services (CAS), shifting accounting professionals from doing the work to reviewing it. The company emphasizes enterprise-grade security and compliance for accounting firms — SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and ISO 42001 certifications, AES-256 encryption, strict tenant isolation, and US-only hosting. Basis is backed by Khosla Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead. It is a product company with no public developer API, SDK, or API reference at this time.

providers.name: Indinero
providers.description: Indinero is a Finance-as-a-Service (FaaS) provider that combines professional accountants, tax experts, and fractional CFOs with AI-accelerated workflows to deliver outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, business tax preparation, payroll, 409A valuations, and on-demand financial support. Founded in 2009 and backed by 500 Global, the company serves startups through $500M+ revenue businesses across technology, SaaS, ecommerce, healthcare, construction, crypto, professional services, and non-profits, integrating primarily with QuickBooks Online and NetSuite. Indinero is SOC 2 compliant and delivers its services through a client portal (the indinero Exchange) rather than a public developer API.

providers.name: Thomson Reuters
providers.description: Thomson Reuters provides over 137 APIs across legal, tax and accounting, risk and fraud, and trade and supply industries through their global developer portal. APIs cover Westlaw legal research, Checkpoint tax content, ONESOURCE tax software, HighQ document management, Legal Tracker matter management, and risk and fraud solutions including identity verification and adverse media screening.

providers.name: Accrual
providers.description: Accrual is an augmented accounting intelligence platform for accounting firms and growing service businesses, offering what it calls the complete accounting workspace spanning engagement management, document intake, data processing, tax return generation, assurance workflows, and client collaboration. Backed by General Catalyst, the company emphasizes secure, US-hosted infrastructure with AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS in transit, data isolation, and SOC 2 Type II attestation, and states that customer data is not used to train AI models. Accrual does not publish a public API or developer program at this time; this profile captures the company identity and its published security posture.

providers.name: Every
providers.description: Every is an AI-native, all-in-one back-office and finance platform built for startups, unifying incorporation, business banking and cards, treasury and cash management, global payroll, HR and benefits, AI-assisted bookkeeping, and startup tax preparation (including R&D tax credits) into a single system. It offers free Delaware C-corp formation, business checking with cashback debit cards, treasury-bill and money-market investing, and bundled per-stage plans for new founders through established startups. Backed by Redpoint Ventures. Every does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer documentation; this profile captures its identity, commercial, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Harness Wealth
providers.description: Harness — the company that launched as Harness Wealth, and today a wholly owned business of Multiplier, Inc. — is a New York City firm that runs an advisory platform for tax and wealth practices. It operates three connected surfaces: a marketplace that matches individuals with complex financial situations (equity compensation, liquidity events, business owners, real estate, high net worth) to vetted tax advisors; a client portal and workflow platform that tax firms run their engagements, documents, questionnaires and e-file on; and Harness Wealth Advisers, LLC, an SEC-registered investment adviser that recommends third-party advisers. Harness publishes no public developer program — there is no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/GraphQL/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, CLI or webhook documentation on any Harness host, and the product is delivered entirely as an end-user web application at app.harness.co.

providers.name: Aiwyn
providers.description: Aiwyn is a practice-automation platform built for modern accounting and CPA firms, unifying payments, practice management, client experience, and tax into a single relationship-centered system. Aiwyn Payments automates invoicing, card and ACH collection, and reconciliation; Aiwyn Practice covers time, billing, project management and resource planning; Aiwyn Experience delivers a unified client portal for engagement letters and secure document exchange; and Aiwyn Tax adds AI-assisted tax preparation. The company serves 800+ firms and raised $113M from KKR and Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced as a Bessemer portfolio company; Aiwyn publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI, or SDK surface at this time, so enrichment is limited to identity, its published llms.txt, and probed domain security.

providers.name: Bhub
providers.description: BHub (bhub.com) is a Brazilian accounting and financial back-office company serving small and medium-sized businesses across Brazil. It combines bookkeeping and tax accounting (contabilidade), financial business-process outsourcing (BPO financeiro) covering accounts payable/receivable and reconciliation, tax consulting (consultoria tributaria), and corporate/legal structuring (societario), delivered through its online client hub at app.bhub.ai. Specialized divisions Agrocontar (agribusiness) and Quality Associados (nonprofit/third sector) extend its sector coverage. Backed by QED Investors, BHub reports processing tens of millions of invoices and reconciling billions of reais annually. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a fintech portfolio lead; BHub currently exposes an internal application backend (api.bhub.com) but publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Taxfix
providers.description: Taxfix is a Berlin-based fintech that lets individuals and self-employed people in Germany prepare and file their annual income tax return from a mobile app or web browser. Users either answer a guided set of roughly 70 questions to self-file (Taxfix Basic) or hand the return to an independent tax expert via the Expert Service, with data transmitted to the tax authority over the official ELSTER interface. The company reports more than 10 million tax returns filed and over 5 billion euros in refunds. Taxfix is a consumer (B2C) product and does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API documentation; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture. Backed by Creandum, Index Ventures and Speedinvest.

providers.name: Topia
providers.description: Topia is a global mobility platform for distributed workforces, used by HR, Finance and Legal teams at mid-market and enterprise companies to manage international assignments, relocations, business travel, remote work and cross-border compliance across 190+ countries in a single system. Founded in 2010 and headquartered in the United States, with additional offices in the United Kingdom, Ireland and Estonia, Topia spans global talent mobility, a tax and compliance engine, cost estimation and tracking, global workforce planning, cost and immigration risk management, and business travel. In April 2026 Topia launched Horizon, an agentic AI workspace for mobility teams that the company describes as built natively into MCP (Model Context Protocol) environments. Topia integrates with HRIS, payroll, travel and expense systems including Workday (a Workday Approved Integration), SAP, ADP, Oracle, Ceridian, SAP Concur and BCD Travel. Topia publishes an llms.txt at its marketing host, but no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable specification; the support center sits behind a customer login.

providers.name: Internal Revenue Service
providers.description: The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) is the United States federal tax collection agency and a bureau of the Department of the Treasury. The IRS publishes developer resources for tax software providers and transmitters including the Modernized e-File (MeF) system for electronic tax return submission, the e-Services suite for authorized e-file providers, and Publication 4164 (the MeF Guide for Software Developers and Transmitters) which documents the XML schemas and transmission protocols required for integration.

providers.name: Aerial Partners
providers.description: Aerial Partners (株式会社Aerial Partners, Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo) builds digital-asset accounting, tax and data-management software for the Japanese market. Its current product line is AWA (Aerial Web3 Accounting), an accounting-support tool for Web3 businesses handling crypto assets and NFTs, and ADM (Aerial Data Management), a management-accounting and statutory-ledger data platform for crypto-asset exchange operators and Type I financial instruments business operators. The company also resells Lukka Insights, the crypto data platform of its parent, Lukka, which acquired Aerial Partners in January 2025. Aerial Partners originated Gtax, the consumer and tax-accountant crypto profit-and-loss calculator, and Guardian, its tax-filing support service; both moved to 株式会社Gtax, which pafin acquired in July 2026 and is folding into Cryptact on 5 October 2026. Aerial Partners publishes no public developer portal, API reference or machine-readable contract: the only API it markets is the "Gtax Network API", a joint-development BtoBtoC offering for exchange operators reachable only through the corporate inquiry form.

providers.name: Exactera
providers.description: Exactera is a corporate tax technology and advisory company that pairs AI-powered software with expert tax professionals to help multinational corporations manage the full corporate tax lifecycle. Its SaaS platform and services span transfer pricing compliance and benchmarking, R&D tax credits, fixed-asset depreciation, indirect (sales and use) tax advisory, tax provision, and the RoyaltyStat royalty-rate and transfer-pricing data platform. Exactera automates documentation, benchmarking studies, and regulatory reporting so tax and finance teams can reduce audit exposure and meet global compliance requirements. Backed by Insight Partners, the company serves enterprise tax departments and advisory firms worldwide.

providers.name: Loctax
providers.description: Loctax is a collaborative tax compliance, risk, and governance platform built for global in-house tax teams. Founded in 2020 and based in Gent, Belgium, its Global Tax Intelligence Platform lets teams ask any tax question grounded in their own company data and IBFD's authoritative tax content spanning 220+ jurisdictions, then act on the answer with workflow, compliance-monitoring, risk, and controversy-management tooling. Loctax is backed by Index Ventures, Cavalry Ventures, and Seedcamp, and in 2026 was acquired by Tax Systems to build a combined EMEA tax-technology platform. Loctax is a closed enterprise SaaS product with no public developer API, portal, or specification at the time of this profile.

providers.name: Alvarez & Marsal
providers.description: Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a leading global professional services firm, founded in 1983 by Tony Alvarez II and Bryan Marsal and headquartered in New York City. Privately held, the firm employs more than 10,000 people across six continents and is best known for turnaround and restructuring engagements (Lehman Brothers, HealthSouth, Tribune, FTX, Arthur Andersen) and for performance improvement, tax advisory, transaction advisory, disputes and investigations, valuation, and private equity performance improvement (PEPI) services. A&M does not operate a public developer portal; technology is delivered through client engagements, internal proprietary tools, A&M Capital Partners (the firm's investment arm), and a public Insights / thought-leadership surface published on alvarezandmarsal.com.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: FlyFin
providers.description: FlyFin is an AI-powered tax preparation and filing platform for freelancers, self-employed individuals, 1099 contractors, sole proprietorships, LLCs, S-Corps, C-Corps, partnerships, and W-2 employees. It pairs an A.I. deduction scanner that connects to 2,000+ financial institutions through Plaid with a team of certified CPAs who prepare and file federal and state returns. The product suite includes a quarterly tax calculator, a CPA-certified AI tax assistant for unlimited questions, audit insurance with IRS representation, and Excel tax-summary exports. FlyFin operates as a consumer mobile and web application (iOS and Android) and does not publish a public developer API. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Accel and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: H&R Block
providers.description: H&R Block is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The H&R Block API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Taxdoo
providers.description: Taxdoo is a Hamburg-based fintech providing real-time e-commerce accounting software for online retailers and tax advisors. The platform automatically captures sales, fees, payments, invoices, and contracts across 50+ marketplaces, shop systems, and payment providers (Amazon, eBay, Kaufland, Shopify, JTL, PayPal, Stripe, Klarna, Mollie), reconciles them into GoBD-compliant, audit-ready financial data, performs AI-based invoice verification, and exports daily to DATEV. Integrations are delivered as managed no-code connectors; Taxdoo does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or API reference. Backed by Accel.

providers.name: Prime Meridian
providers.description: Prime Meridian (Prime Meridian Labs) is an AI-powered consumer tax preparation and e-filing service that files federal and state income tax returns for free. Users upload their tax documents, answer a few clarifying questions, and the platform's AI generates a plain-language return covering W-2 employment, self-employment (Schedule C), K-1 partnership income, and multi-state situations, then e-files it with the IRS and state authorities in roughly fifteen minutes. The company is backed by General Catalyst and counts former IRS Commissioner Daniel Werfel among its strategic advisors. It is a consumer web application with no public developer API surface at this time.

providers.name: Numbi
providers.description: Numbi is a tech-enabled accounting and payroll firm for Colombian companies — especially SAS entities, SMBs, and startups. It pairs expert accountants with automation and AI to run monthly bookkeeping, taxes, payroll, and DIAN electronic-invoicing compliance. Numbi is a service rather than software or an ERP: it operates on top of a company's existing accounting systems (Siigo and Alegra) instead of replacing them, ingesting documents (PDFs, XMLs, images) and keeping tax calendars and filings current. Founded in Bogotá and backed by Homebrew and Newtopia VC. No public developer API surface is published as of this pass.

providers.name: Velotax
providers.description: Velotax is a Brazilian digital-credit fintech (mobile app plus velotax.com.br), operating 100% online, that offers unsecured personal loans and income-tax (IRPF) refund advances, disbursed via Pix within 30 minutes of approval — approving even "negativado" (poor-credit) customers because the anticipated tax refund secures repayment. Founded in 2020 by ex-J.P. Morgan bankers Eduardo Esmanhotto and Victor Savioli, it operates as a banking correspondent in partnership with VIA CAPITAL (a Brazilian Central Bank SCD), holds Reclame Aqui's top RA1000 reputation seal, has 3M+ app downloads, and raised a R$125M Series A in 2025 from QED Investors, Valor Capital and Picus Capital. Velotax is a consumer product and publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Stride Health
providers.description: Stride Health is a benefits platform that helps independent, gig, and part-time workers access portable benefits that stay with the individual regardless of where or how they work. Stride connects people to affordable health, dental, vision, and life insurance, and provides tax tools, mileage/expense tracking, and savings features for the self-employed. The company reports 4.6 million independent workers served, $8+ billion saved on insurance and taxes, and 130+ partner companies. Stride operates a private B2B partner integration (embedded in partner apps such as gig-work platforms) but publishes no public developer API, API documentation, or developer portal.

providers.name: Taxscouts
providers.description: TaxScouts is a UK online tax-return and Self Assessment service that pairs individuals, sole traders, landlords and investors with accredited accountants to prepare, review and file their taxes with HMRC for a flat fee. Founded in London, TaxScouts was acquired by Taxfix and its taxscouts.com domain now redirects to taxfix.com/en-uk. The service is a consumer-facing web and mobile product with pricing tiers for one-off filing, optimisation with HMRC audit protection, and year-round accountant support. As of this profile it exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable API documentation; this record captures its public identity and web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: CoinTracker
providers.description: CoinTracker is a cryptocurrency portfolio tracker and crypto tax software that connects a user's exchange accounts and blockchain wallets to automatically track holdings, calculate cost basis and capital gains, and generate tax reports and IRS forms. It supports a large catalog of exchanges, wallets, and cryptocurrencies, and offers tax-loss harvesting, performance tracking, and integrations with consumer tax-filing products. For developers and partners, CoinTracker publishes a first-party JavaScript SDK (@cointracker/tax-kit) for supplying cost-basis data; its core HTTP API is offered through enterprise and partner integrations rather than a self-serve public developer program. This profile was surfaced as a VC-portfolio lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline from publicly discoverable surfaces (npm, GitHub, status page, DNS/TLS).

providers.name: Solomon
providers.description: Solomon (Solomon AI, solomontax.ai) is an agentic AI platform for tax preparation aimed at accounting firms, automating the preparation of review-ready individual 1040 returns for high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients. The system interprets K-1/K-3 footnotes, applies multi-state SALT rules to K-1s, reconciles rental and real estate investments, analyzes brokerage statements for foreign income, and produces workpapers and audit trails, positioning itself to replace legacy tools such as SurePrep and K1x. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes no public developer/API surface at this time.

providers.name: CohnReznick
providers.description: CohnReznick is a top-25 US accounting, tax, and advisory firm formed in 2012 by the merger of J.H. Cohn LLP and Reznick Group, P.C. The firm serves clients across more than 30 industries from offices throughout the United States and four offshore subsidiaries, with its global reach extended through membership in the Nexia International network (operating in more than 128 countries). In May 2024 CohnReznick became the first US accounting firm of its scale to receive a strategic growth investment from a private equity sponsor when funds advised by Apax Partners acquired a majority stake. As part of that transaction the firm operates under an alternative-practice structure: audit and attest services are delivered by CohnReznick LLP (a licensed CPA firm) while tax and advisory services are delivered through CohnReznick Advisory LLC. Largest practice areas include Real Estate, Renewable Energy, Government Contracting, Asset Management (private equity, hedge funds, private credit, REITs), Financial Services, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Consumer & Industrial, Technology & Media, Public Sector, and Private Clients (family offices, high net worth individuals, professional sports). CohnReznick does not publish a public software developer API; this repository documents the firm's organizational profile, practice taxonomy, and linked-data context for API catalog purposes.

providers.name: ExpressSteuer (fka Express Group)
providers.description: ExpressSteuer (formerly Express Group) is a German tax-technology company, originally a Hamburg-based fintech backed by Insight Partners that offered an app-based, largely automated income-tax-return (Steuererklärung) service aimed at consumers and employees. The expresssteuer.de domain currently presents a German-language tax-information and guidance website (built on WordPress) covering income tax, self-employment, and everyday financial topics. No public developer program, API, SDK, or /.well-known/ discovery surface is published. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead for enrichment.

providers.name: Crete Professionals Alliance
providers.description: Crete Professionals Alliance (rebranded in 2025 as "Current", current.co) is a growth platform for independent accounting firms, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners. The alliance provides member firms with technology, talent, capital, and strategy to compete at enterprise scale, spanning 48 partner firms across 39 states and 3 countries with more than 2,000 employees. Service lines include accounting, advisory, audit and attest, client accounting services, and tax. This is a professional services / accounting company, not a developer-facing API provider: it publishes no developer portal, API, SDKs, or technical documentation. The record is maintained in the API Evangelist network for portfolio-graph coverage of Bessemer holdings.

providers.name: EY
providers.description: One of the Big Four professional services firms providing audit, tax, consulting, and advisory services. Operates in over 150 countries helping businesses navigate regulatory and strategic challenges, and runs proprietary technology platforms such as EY Helix (analytics), EY Atlas (research), and EY Canvas (audit) for internal and engagement use.

providers.name: PwC (PricewaterhouseCoopers)
providers.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the Big Four professional services firms, with approximately 370,000 staff across a global network of member firms coordinated by PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwCIL). PwC organizes delivery across three primary service lines — Assurance (audit), Tax (tax compliance, planning, and reporting), and Advisory (consulting, deals, and risk). The firm operates proprietary technology platforms including PwC Halo (a suite of data analytics tools used to support audit engagements), the Trusted AI initiative (PwC's responsible-AI governance and assurance framework), and ProEdge (a workforce upskilling platform). In April 2024 PwC announced a multi-year alliance with OpenAI positioning the firm as both OpenAI's largest customer and its first reseller of ChatGPT Enterprise, supporting PwC's broader generative-AI consulting practice. PwC's research and insights surface — pwc.com/insights, the annual Global CEO Survey, the Global Workforce Hopes and Fears Survey, the Money Tree report, and regional industry outlooks — is the firm's primary public-facing knowledge product. PwC does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI specifications, partner API documentation, or a GitHub organization at the corporate level. The github.com/pwc handle is held by an unrelated individual user (Patrick Clearwater). Any technical integrations with PwC platforms are arranged through engagement contracts and the PwC Technology Consulting practice rather than through self-service developer credentials. PwC's content distribution is reader-facing (newsletter subscriptions, the PwC US Newsroom, LinkedIn, YouTube) with no documented public RSS feed endpoint exposing news, press releases, or insights as a syndication contract.

providers.name: Carr, Riggs & Ingram (CRI)
providers.description: Carr, Riggs & Ingram (CRI) is a top-25 nationally ranked accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Alabama, operating 70+ locations across 13 states plus Mexico. The firm delivers audit and attest, tax, and advisory services (cybersecurity, fraud and forensics, valuations, and transaction advisory) to more than 18 industries, alongside value add-on subsidiaries including CRI Advanced Analytics, CRI CFO Hub, and CRI M&A Advisors, and is a member of PrimeGlobal. It was surfaced via the VC-portfolio pipeline and enriched here; note that criadv.com is a professional-services accounting firm, not a Bessemer-backed fintech startup, so the portfolio-lead tagging is a domain false-positive. No public API, developer portal, or documentation surface exists.

providers.name: Folhamatic
providers.description: Folhamatic (IOB Folhamatic Group) is a Brazilian developer of integrated accounting, payroll, and fiscal/tax software for accounting firms and businesses, founded in 1990 and headquartered in Americana, Sao Paulo. Its product line includes Folhamatic Payroll for personnel management and electronic files, Electronic Point Control for time-clock management, the Folhamatic Accounting system for management reporting, and Folhamatic Written Tax for tax departments. At acquisition it served more than 11,000 companies with 500-plus employees. Folhamatic was acquired by the UK's Sage Group in June 2012 and now operates as part of Sage in Brazil. The company publishes no first-party public developer API, and the historic folhamatic.com.br domain no longer serves a live site.

providers.name: LumaTax
providers.description: LumaTax is a US and Canadian sales tax automation platform that helps businesses automate sales tax filings, manage nexus exposure, and streamline remittance across multiple state and federal jurisdictions. The product imports transaction data from sources such as Amazon, Stripe, Shopify, and Excel, validates that data and assigns correct tax jurisdictions, generates categorized return summaries, files returns automatically, and stores past filings for audit preparation. Originally an independent Seattle fintech backed by Cowboy Ventures, LumaTax was acquired and is now offered as a product line under Taxually alongside CrossTax, EcoTax, and OneTax. As of enrichment it exposes no public developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: PwC
providers.description: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is one of the Big Four professional services firms providing audit and assurance, tax, and management consulting services globally. PwC operates as a network of member firms across approximately 150 countries with hundreds of thousands of professionals. Service lines include audit, deals and transactions, tax compliance and advisory, risk assurance, cybersecurity and privacy, ESG and sustainability assurance, workforce transformation, and digital/technology consulting (cloud, data, AI, ERP). PwC publishes thought-leadership content and operates client portals for engagement delivery and document exchange, but it does not publish a public developer API or open partner integration portal at the corporate level - client connectivity is bilateral and project-scoped rather than offered as a self-serve API product.

providers.name: Sabrix
providers.description: Sabrix was a transaction (indirect / sales & use) tax determination and compliance software company whose engine calculated sales, use, VAT and GST taxes for enterprise ERP and billing systems. Sabrix was acquired by Thomson Reuters in 2009 and folded into the Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE Indirect Tax product line. As an independent brand Sabrix no longer operates: the sabrix.com domain is now owned by Thomson Reuters (Thomson Reuters nameservers) and issues a 301 redirect to tax.thomsonreuters.com/en/onesource/indirect-tax. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as a historical fintech / tax-tech lead; there is no independent Sabrix developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI definition, SDK, or well-known surface to enrich. Any live tax API surface lives under the Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE brand.

providers.name: TrustWeaver
providers.description: TrustWeaver was a Stockholm-based provider of on-demand e-invoicing and e-signature compliance services, giving multinational enterprises legally compliant electronic invoicing (VAT/tax compliance, authenticity and integrity via digital signatures) across dozens of countries. Backed by Creandum, the company was acquired by Pagero in 2018; Pagero was subsequently absorbed into Sovos (2024). The trustweaver.com domain now issues a 301 redirect to Sovos's e-invoicing compliance solution, so no independent TrustWeaver developer portal, public API, or API documentation remains online. This profile is retained as a historical/acquisition lead in the API Evangelist network; there is no standalone API surface to enrich.

providers.name: WISECRICKET HOLDING KY
providers.description: WiseCricket (WISECRICKET HOLDING KY) offers AI-powered fiscal and accounting audit software for businesses ("Software de Auditoria Fiscal y Contable con IA para Empresas"). The Spanish-language platform applies artificial intelligence to tax and accounting compliance, helping companies automate financial and tax audits and surface issues. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub; enrichment found a marketing landing page but no public developer API, documentation, developer portal, or well-known discovery surface.

providers.name: Duane Morris
providers.description: Duane Morris LLP is a Philadelphia-headquartered, full-service U.S. and international law firm founded in 1904 by Russell Duane, Steven Heckscher, and Roland S. Morris. Chaired by Matthew A. Taylor, the firm describes itself as "a law firm with more than 900 attorneys in offices across the United States and internationally" — with a U.S. footprint spanning the East Coast, Texas, the Mountain West, and California, plus international offices in London, Singapore, Vietnam (Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City), Shanghai, Myanmar, and joint ventures/alliances reaching Mexico and Latin America. An Am Law 100 firm since 2001, Duane Morris is known for depth in intellectual property (including patent prosecution and PTAB practice), trial and appellate litigation, real estate, corporate transactions, employment, healthcare, cannabis, and life sciences. The firm publishes an extensive LexBlog-powered thought-leadership network of more than 50 practice-area blogs, all of which expose RSS 2.0 feeds via the standard WordPress /feed/ convention. Duane Morris does not expose any public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec, GraphQL endpoint, webhooks, status page, or developer portal; the GitHub organization github.com/duanemorris exists but has no public repositories. The firm's only machine-readable surfaces are the RSS feeds of its blog network.

providers.name: Blank Rome LLP
providers.description: Blank Rome LLP is an Am Law 100 U.S. law firm founded in 1946 and headquartered in Philadelphia, with approximately 600+ attorneys across roughly 14 U.S. offices plus an international presence (Shanghai). The firm provides comprehensive legal and government-advocacy services across commercial and corporate litigation, corporate / M&A and finance, restructuring and bankruptcy, government contracts, intellectual property, labor and employment, real estate, tax, white-collar defense, matrimonial and family law, and a nationally recognized maritime and international trade practice. Blank Rome Government Relations LLC, the firm's affiliated lobbying arm, operates from Washington, D.C. The firm publishes practice-area client alerts, the Mainbrace maritime newsletter, and industry insights through its website's News & Events and Publications sections. Blank Rome does not operate a public developer program, REST/GraphQL API, SDK ecosystem, or GitHub organization; this profile catalogs the firm's public-facing knowledge surface (practice pages, newsletters, alerts) rather than a developer platform.

providers.name: Ballard Spahr
providers.description: Ballard Spahr LLP is a national U.S. law firm founded in 1885 and headquartered in Philadelphia. Following its January 1, 2025 combination with Seattle-based Lane Powell, the firm operates as a "nationally recognized firm of more than 750 lawyers across 18 U.S. offices" with departments in Business and Transactions, Finance, Intellectual Property, Litigation, and Real Estate. The firm has historic depth in consumer financial services, real estate, public finance, and IP, and runs widely read thought-leadership properties including the Consumer Finance Monitor blog (with public RSS feed) and the Business Better podcast. Ballard Spahr does not expose any public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI spec, or developer portal — its only machine-readable surface is the Consumer Finance Monitor RSS feed.

providers.name: Dechert
providers.description: Dechert LLP is a global law firm founded in 1875 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, with "more than 900 lawyers" across 22 offices in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia (Wikipedia cites roughly 1,000 attorneys in 20 offices; the firm itself emphasizes a global footprint spanning the U.S., Europe, Asia, and the Middle East). The firm is known for market-leading practices in financial services and investment management, private equity, private credit, mergers and acquisitions, international arbitration, intellectual property, life sciences, white collar enforcement, and antitrust. Dechert publishes deep thought-leadership through its OnPoint series, Crypto Bytes, FSR Radar, THE CRED, and ReTorts; produces multiple podcasts (Dechert 4 Real, Committed Capital, Dechert On Reg); and operates proprietary information platforms including DAMITT (Dechert Antitrust Merger Investigation Timing Tracker), World Compass, World Passport, Dechert Direct, and a Box Portal. Despite these data-driven products, Dechert does not expose any public developer API, SDK, OpenAPI specification, GraphQL endpoint, webhook surface, status page, changelog, or developer portal, and does not publish an RSS feed for OnPoint or any blog series — its only public-facing subscription mechanism is an email preference form.
